name: depression-support
description: Choose a practical activity, plan its steps and compare time estimates.

interface.longDescription: Choose a practical activity, plan its steps and compare time estimates. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Shortlist activities for your available time; Plan activity steps and a time allowance; Compare planned and actual activity time. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring. General personal and project organization. Uses only supplied task, project or schedule data. No healthcare records, clinical scoring, treatment, background reminders or external account access.
defaultPrompt: Help me shortlist activities for your available time.
Help me plan activity steps and a time allowance.

prompts: Help me shortlist activities for your available time.
Help me plan activity steps and a time allowance.
Help me compare planned and actual activity time.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Small Steps: Activity Planner workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Shortlist activities for your available time. Reproducible inputs: {"available_minutes":30,"location":"indoors","activities":[{"name":"Repot the basil","minutes":20,"location":"indoors","materials_ready":"ready"},{"name":"Clean the patio","minutes":45,"location":"outdoors","materials_ready":"ready"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me shortlist activities for your available time with these supplied values: {"available_minutes":30,"location":"indoors","activities":[{"name":"Repot the basil","minutes":20,"location":"indoors","materials_ready":"ready"},{"name":"Clean the patio","minutes":45,"location":"outdoors","materials_ready":"ready"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses activity_planner_activity_shortlist with the supplied inputs. Returns {"shortlist":[{"name":"Repot the basil","minutes":20,"location":"indoors","materials_ready":"ready","fits_time":true,"fits_location":true,"ready_to_start":true},{"name":"Clean the patio","minutes":45,"location":"outdoors","materials_ready":"ready","fits_time":false,"fits_location":false,"ready_to_start":true}],"available_minutes":30}. Shows the actual activity result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Plan activity steps and a time allowance. Reproducible inputs: {"activity":"Organize a shelf","steps":[{"action":"Empty the shelf","minutes":5},{"action":"Sort and replace items","minutes":15}],"buffer_minutes":5}
positive.prompt: Help me plan activity steps and a time allowance with these supplied values: {"activity":"Organize a shelf","steps":[{"action":"Empty the shelf","minutes":5},{"action":"Sort and replace items","minutes":15}],"buffer_minutes":5}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses activity_planner_activity_steps with the supplied inputs. Returns {"activity":"Organize a shelf","steps":[{"action":"Empty the shelf","minutes":5},{"action":"Sort and replace items","minutes":15}],"buffer_minutes":5,"action_minutes":20,"planned_minutes":25}. Shows the actual steps result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare planned and actual activity time. Reproducible inputs: {"entries":[{"activity":"Organize shelf","planned_minutes":25,"actual_minutes":30},{"activity":"Water plants","planned_minutes":10,"actual_minutes":8}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare planned and actual activity time with these supplied values: {"entries":[{"activity":"Organize shelf","planned_minutes":25,"actual_minutes":30},{"activity":"Water plants","planned_minutes":10,"actual_minutes":8}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses activity_planner_time_estimate_review with the supplied inputs. Returns {"activities":[{"activity":"Organize shelf","planned_minutes":25,"actual_minutes":30,"difference_minutes":5},{"activity":"Water plants","planned_minutes":10,"actual_minutes":8,"difference_minutes":-2}],"planned_total":35,"actual_total":38}. Shows the actual bars result. Does not fabricate external data.
